title: Query lower bound for odd parity testing
statement: Let $n$ be a positive natural number, and let a nonadaptive randomized tester query Boolean strings of length $n$ at $r<n$ positions. For every real rate, this tester cannot have perfect acceptance on all odd-parity strings and rejection probability strictly greater than the rate times $\varepsilon$ on every string whose relative Hamming distance from every odd-parity string exceeds $\varepsilon$, for all $0\le\varepsilon\le1$.
hypotheses_covered: the tester is nonadaptive and queries Boolean strings of length $n$
the number $r$ of query positions satisfies $r<n$
